image_based_abuse.label: Image-based abuse (non-consensual intimate images, threats to share)
steps: Report immediately to the platform where the image was shared or threatened (use their 'non-consensual intimate imagery' reporting category if available).
Report to SAPS - this is a criminal offence under the Films and Publications Act and the Cybercrimes Act in South Africa.
Keep the original threat message, sender's account details, and timestamps - do not delete anything, even if it's upsetting.

cyberstalking.label: Cyberstalking (repeated unwanted contact, tracking, monitoring)
steps: Document a pattern over time - a single message is rarely enough, log each incident with date and time.
Report to SAPS, especially if the person has shown up in person or knows your location.
Report the account(s) to the platform for harassment/stalking.

doxxing.label: Doxxing (private information shared publicly)
steps: Screenshot the original post before it can be edited or deleted.
Report to the platform for 'sharing private information' or 'doxxing'.
If it leads to threats or people showing up at your location, report to SAPS immediately.

impersonation.label: Impersonation (fake account using your name/photos)
steps: Screenshot the fake profile including the URL/handle.
Report to the platform's impersonation reporting form - most require proof of your real identity.
Warn contacts who may be targeted by the fake account.

coordinated_harassment.label: Coordinated harassment / pile-on
steps: Screenshot a representative sample of the abusive messages/comments, not every single one.
Report the ringleader account(s) and use mass-reporting tools if the platform offers them.
Consider temporarily locking your account while reporting is processed.

sextortion.label: Sextortion (threats to release images unless paid or more content sent)
steps: Do not pay and do not send more content - this rarely stops the threat.
Report to SAPS immediately - this is a criminal offence.
Report to the platform and preserve all payment demands/threats as evidence.

threats_of_violence.label: Threats of violence
steps: Report to SAPS immediately, especially if the threat is specific or includes a time/place.
Report to the platform for a direct threat violation.
Tell someone you trust where you are and what's happening.
